correctness.rationale: Finite-rate reset ancestry constructs unique centered stationary law with finite variances for finite N. Exact generator identities give c_11=q1/r and c_1j=c_1,j−1/2; the lower-triangular conditional-mean propagator gives both directional kernels for any independent centered finite-variance Lévy noises. Differentiating gives strictly decreasing S_m(λ), one maximum, λ=2m−2+O(1/m), Stirling peak V sqrt(2/(πm)); termwise gamma integration gives V/r(2−2^-m) and V/r 2^-m. Independently evaluated m=1,2,5,10,100 roots and heights, inspected verification program source; tails/asymptotics rely on provided estimates, not finite checks.
